title: CONSORT 2010 flow diagram schema
description: A schema for generating CONSORT 2010 flow diagrams.

diagram_type.description: The type of diagram to generate.

assessed_for_eligibility.description: Number of participants assessed for eligibility.

excluded.description: Number of participants excluded before randomization.

excluded_before_randomization.description: Number of participants excluded before randomization.

intervention_group_allocated.description: Number of participants allocated to intervention group.

intervention_group_received.description: Number of participants who received intervention.

intervention_group_lost_to_follow_up.description: Number of participants in intervention group lost to follow-up.

intervention_group_discontinued.description: Number of participants in intervention group who discontinued intervention.

intervention_group_analysed.description: Number of participants in intervention group analysed.

control_group_allocated.description: Number of participants allocated to control group.

control_group_received.description: Number of participants who received control.

control_group_lost_to_follow_up.description: Number of participants in control group lost to follow-up.

control_group_discontinued.description: Number of participants in control group who discontinued intervention.

control_group_analysed.description: Number of participants in control group analysed.

clusters_assessed_for_eligibility.description: Number of clusters assessed for eligibility.

clusters_allocated_to_intervention.description: Number of clusters allocated to intervention.

individuals_in_clusters_allocated_to_int.description: Number of individuals in clusters allocated to intervention.

clusters_lost_to_follow_up.description: Number of clusters lost to follow-up.

individuals_lost_to_follow_up.description: Number of individuals lost to follow-up.

reasons_for_cluster_loss_to_follow_up.description: Reasons for cluster loss to follow-up.

clusters_discontinued_intervention.description: Number of clusters that discontinued intervention.

individuals_discontinued_intervention.description: Number of individuals who discontinued intervention.

clusters_excluded_from_analysis.description: Number of clusters excluded from analysis.

individuals_excluded_from_analysis.description: Number of individuals excluded from analysis.

reasons_for_cluster_exclusion_from_analy.description: Reasons for cluster exclusion from analysis.

box_color.description: The background color of the boxes.

font_color.description: The color of the text in the boxes.

font_name.description: The name of the font to use for the text.

font_size.description: The size of the font to use for the text.
